test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

She said, “I will dance tomorrow.”

options.text: She said that she would dance the next day.
She said that she would dance tomorrow.
She said she would dance the next day.
She said that she will dance tomorrow.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the reporting verb **'said'** is followed by a reported statement.
 
• **Comma (,) **and inverted **commas ("...") **will be **removed** in the conversion to indirect speech.
 
• Instead of** 'will'**,** 'would'** is used in indirect speech to indicate **future **in the past.
 
• The pronoun** 'I' **changes to** 'she'** aligning with the subject 'She' in the reporting clause.
 
• The adverb **'tomorrow' **changes to** 'the next day'. (See additional info)**
 
• The conjunction **'that' **is typically added in the conversion from direct to indirect speech for declarative sentences.

**Therefore, the indirect speech conversion is *"She said that she would dance the next day."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let’s identify the reporting speech and reported speech.

 
 
• He said, “I go to school every day.”
 
• In the above sentence “He said” is the reporting speech.
 
• “I go to school every day.” is the reported speech.
